name: 2.39:1 Anamorphic Squeeze & Flare
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Use `2.39:1 Panavision anamorphic lens, subtle blue horizontal optical flare, crisp oval specular bokeh, mild barrel breathing at edges` while keeping the center facial anatomy razor true.

name: 24mm Low-Angle Monumental Hero
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Place lens low near waist/knee level looking upward (`24mm wide low-angle shot`), magnifying vertical architecture and shoulders against dramatic upper clouds or neon eaves.

name: Intentional Dutch Horizon Cant
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Apply subtle `15-degree Dutch horizon tilt` aligned diagonally with staircase rails or rooftops to evoke kinetic urgency and psychological tension without making faces illegible.

name: Tight Over-The-Shoulder Tension
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Anchor one softly defocused foreground shoulder/ear along the left/right border (`over-the-shoulder two-shot, 50mm f/2.0`) aiming cleanly toward the opposing subject's eyes.

name: Geometric Leading Lines Convergence
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Align curb lines, ceiling ribs, bridge suspension cables, or riverbanks asymmetrically straight toward the focal subject on the third intersection.

name: Asymmetric Gaze Space & Balance
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Anchor subject cleanly on the left or right vertical third leaving generous open lead space in the direction of gaze or travel rather than centering by default.

name: One-Point Architectural Symmetry
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Lock camera plumb along the exact geometric axis (`strict one-point center perspective, level horizon, mirrored flanking columns`), amplifying formal stillness.

name: Handheld Verite Documentary
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Simulate shoulder-rig immediacy (`handheld 35mm cinema rig, subtle organic breathing, slight foreground obstruction`) placing viewer directly inside the crowd or cockpit.

name: Floating Steadicam Follow
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Maintain fluid floating eye-level separation ahead of or behind moving actors (`smooth Steadicam glide tracking through doorways`) keeping horizon crisp across spatial transitions.

name: Banked Aerial Drone Sweep
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Use `slow steady aerial gimbal forward push, horizon locked, smooth ridge parallax` with crisp foreground peaks drifting cleanly past sunlit distant valleys.

name: 180° Parallax Arc Around Subject
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Sweep laterally in a tight smooth circular arc keeping the hero anchored dead-center while background architecture and flares counter-scroll continuously.

name: Deliberate Slow Dolly Push-In
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Execute steady straight-track dolly progression from medium-wide toward tight close-up (`gradual 35mm dolly push-in`), building emotional focus smoothly without zoom flattening.

name: Kinetic Whip-Pan Energy
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Reserve rapid horizontal pan streak blur strictly for snappy transitional mid-beats settling cleanly into sharp locked framing on impact or reveal.

name: Rising Jib Horizon Reveal
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Begin tight behind a foreground rock, wall, or battlement and smoothly elevate the boom upward to unveil a vast sunlit canyon, fleet, or skyline beyond.

name: Shallow Rack-Focus Plane Pull
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Stage a clear near foreground prop (`raindrop window glass, lantern, hilt`) against a distant background subject so shifting focal planes reads cinematically crisp.

name: 200mm Telephoto Spatial Compression
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Shoot via `200mm f/2.8 telephoto`: compress distant bridges, rising harvest moons, or mountain tiers closely behind the subject with creamy out-of-focus foreground haze.

name: 14mm Ultrawide Environmental Span
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Anchor strong nearby floor texture (cracked ice, cobbles, dashboard) inches from `14mm ultrawide glass` pulling the viewer into sweeping overhead ceilings or canyons.

name: Chest-Locked Subject Mount
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Lock subject torso and panicked expression rigidly in foreground center while neon corridors or alley walls streak backward with wide `20mm` motion distortion.

name: Optical Mirror & Glass Double-Frame
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Compose nested spatial reflections through rainy train windows, brass mirrors, or wet marble floors showing dual perspectives cleanly in one frame.

name: Architectural Frame-Within-Frame
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Shoot through darker interior archways, torii gates, or cockpit canopies (`natural vignette frame-within-frame`) isolating the lit hero against deep foreground silhouettes.

name: 90° Overhead Tableau
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Place lens dead vertical (`90-degree top-down god's-eye angle`) highlighting graphic spiral staircases, umbrella canopies in rain, or footprints in fresh snow.

name: Locked Tripod Wide Tableau
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Lock camera solidly on a tripod so architectural geometry holds dead still while subtle life—wind, steam, flickering signs, or walking figures—ripples naturally through frame.
